prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1496; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection, complaining of neck and low back pain with associated stiffness and muscle tension. The reported mechanism and force of the collision are consistent with the soft tissue injuries described. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions is known from history or records. Eighteen visits were completed over the course of care, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for uncomplicated cervical and lumbar strain, and treatment included manual therapy, targeted exercise, and modalities for symptom control. Cervical and lumbar imaging showed no acute fracture, malalignment, or structural abnormality, and neurological and orthopedic examination findings were within normal limits. Diagnoses are based largely on the patient's self-reported pain and functional limitations, as objective findings were limited. Billed services reflect the treatment rendered, with no duplicate charges identified. Patient is advised to continue home exercise and to return if symptoms worsen or fail to improve with ongoing self-management.
